name: web-dark-indigo-fintech-agent-landing-page
title: Dark indigo landing page for an AI payment product with floating cards
whatItIs: A full-length dark landing page with a big headline and a hero of two tilted 3D payment cards, logo strip, feature cards in a 3x2 grid with one highlighted in indigo, a numbered three-step section with a plug graphic, a three-tier pricing table with the middle plan in bright indigo, testimonials, FAQ accordion and final CTA.
whatItMeans: Technical and trustworthy in a nighttime palette; indigo glow shows the featured item in each section.
techniques: Highlight one card in each group with the brand indigo.
Use a radial glow behind each section to break the black.
Present steps with giant thin numerals.
Make the middle pricing card the brightest.
Use tilted 3D objects as hero art.

vocabulary.definition: The one card in a group given the accent colour.
A soft circular light behind a section.
Side-by-side plans with the recommended one emphasised.
